entities.summary: The Church of Saint-Ignace is a large Roman Catholic chapel located at 33 Rue de Sèvres in the 6th arrondissement of Paris. Is is dedicated to Saint Ignace de Loyola, founder of Companions of Jesus, or Jesuits.
